verdict.rationale: Riveter documents an official Go SDK (github.com/riveterhq/riveter-go) with typed client methods for Enrich and Runs.List, plus SDK handling of auth, retries, long-polling, and pagination, indicating a maintained official SDK ecosystem for AI-native/agentic workflows. missing for 10: no evidence of multi-language SDK coverage (e.g., Python/JS) or independent third-party corroboration beyond the vendor's own repo/docs.
